unit.title: How does this photo look?
canDo: Describe visible appearance without claiming hidden facts
Compare 看起来 and 看上去 in observation
Ask permission before using a photograph

grammar.purpose: Mark appearance or an initial impression
grammar.explanation: 看起来 introduces how something appears, often from observation or combined clues: 照片看起来很亮. It does not certify size, temperature, safety or another person’s inner state. An observed comparison may depend on perspective or lighting.

examples.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān kàn qi lái hěn liàng .

examples.zh: 桥看起来很近，实际还要走一会儿。
examples.py: qiáo kàn qi lái hěn jìn , shí jì hái yào zǒu yī huì er .
examples.en: The bridge looks near, but it still takes a while to reach.

examples.zh: 他看起来很安静，我们还没问他的想法。
examples.py: tā kàn qi lái hěn ān jìng , wǒ men hái méi wèn tā de xiǎng fǎ .
examples.en: He looks quiet; we have not yet asked his thoughts.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看起来近，所以一定就在旁边。
commonMistakes.right: 看起来近，实际距离还要确认。
commonMistakes.why: Appearance is not a confirmed distance.

grammar.explanation: 看上去 often emphasizes visual appearance and frequently overlaps with 看起来. There is no strict rule that one proves reality and the other means falsehood. Keep the description linked to what is visible: 石头看上去很大. A picture’s framing can affect the impression.

examples.py: shí tou kàn shàng qu hěn dà .
tú huà kàn shàng qu xiàng zhào piān .
examples.en: The drawing looks like a photograph.

examples.zh: 这里看上去很美，但还没确认能不能进入。
examples.py: zhè lǐ kàn shàng qu hěn měi , dàn hái méi què rèn néng bù néng jìn rù .
examples.en: This place looks beautiful, but entry permission is unconfirmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看上去美，所以一定安全。
commonMistakes.right: 看上去美，安全还要另外确认。
commonMistakes.why: Aesthetic appearance is not proof of safety.

lines.zh: 你昨天发的照片，是在哪里拍的？
lines.py: nǐ zuó tiān fā de zhào piān , shì zài nǎ lǐ pāi de ?
lines.en: Where did you take the photo you sent yesterday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 河边。你看照片里的那座桥。
lines.py: hé biān . nǐ kàn zhào piān lǐ de nà zuò qiáo .
lines.en: By the river. Look at the bridge in the photo.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 看起来很近，你们走过去了吗？
lines.py: kàn qǐ lái hěn jìn , nǐ men zǒu guò qù le ma ?
lines.en: It looks close. Did you walk there?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 走了二十分钟，比照片里远。
lines.py: zǒu le èr shí fēn zhōng , bǐ zhào piān lǐ yuǎn .
lines.en: It took twenty minutes; it's farther than it looks in the photo.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这块石头看上去也很大。
lines.py: zhè kuài shí tou kàn shàng qù yě hěn dà .
lines.en: The rock looks big too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 其实不高，我坐上去刚好能把脚放在地上。
lines.py: qí shí bù gāo , wǒ zuò shàng qù gāng hǎo néng bǎ jiǎo fàng zài dì shang .
lines.en: It's not tall. Sitting on it, I could put my feet on the ground.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 照片里的天空真蓝，景色很美。
lines.py: zhào piān lǐ de tiān kōng zhēn lán , jǐng sè hěn měi .
lines.en: The sky is so blue in the photo. The scenery is beautiful.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 上午有阳光，下午就下雨了。我们赶紧往桥那边走。
lines.py: shàng wǔ yǒu yáng guāng , xià wǔ jiù xià yǔ le . wǒ men gǎn jǐn wǎng qiáo nà biān zǒu .
lines.en: It was sunny in the morning but rained in the afternoon. We hurried towards the bridge.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我下次也想去，你带我吧？
lines.py: wǒ xià cì yě xiǎng qù , nǐ dài wǒ ba ?
lines.en: I'd like to go next time. Will you take me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，带双好走的鞋。我的鞋里全是沙子。
lines.py: hǎo , dài shuāng hǎo zǒu de xié . wǒ de xié lǐ quán shì shā zi .
lines.en: Sure. Bring shoes you can walk in. Mine were full of sand.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那你先把沙子倒出来，别带到我家。
lines.py: nà nǐ xiān bǎ shā zi dào chū lái , bié dài dào wǒ jiā .
lines.en: Empty the sand first. Don't bring it into my home.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 放心，我回家才发现，已经倒过了。
lines.py: fàng xīn , wǒ huí jiā cái fā xiàn , yǐ jīng dào guò le .
lines.en: Don't worry. I found it when I got home and emptied them already.
lines.speaker: b

choices: The bridge is farther away than the photo suggests

reading.title: Look, then ask
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 朋友发给我一张河边的照片。天空很蓝，阳光照着石头，远处有一座桥。我看着照片，觉得这个地方很美，也想去一次。
lines.py: péng you fā gěi wǒ yī zhāng hé biān de zhào piān . tiān kōng hěn lán , yáng guāng zhào zhe shí tou , yuǎn chù yǒu yī zuò qiáo . wǒ kàn zhe zhào piān , jué de zhè gè dì fāng hěn měi , yě xiǎng qù yī cì .
lines.en: A friend sent a riverside photo. The sky was blue, sunlight fell on a rock, and a bridge stood in the distance. It looked beautiful, and I wanted to visit.

lines.zh: 她说照片是上午拍的，下午下了雨。我问桥是不是就在旁边，她笑着说从石头那里走过去要二十分钟。
lines.py: tā shuō zhào piān shì shàng wǔ pāi de , xià wǔ xià le yǔ . wǒ wèn qiáo shì bú shì jiù zài páng biān , tā xiào zhe shuō cóng shí tou nà lǐ zǒu guò qù yào èr shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: She had taken the photo in the morning; it rained in the afternoon. When I asked if the bridge was nearby, she laughed: it was a twenty-minute walk from the rock.

lines.zh: 第二个周末，我们带水和一点吃的去河边。她指给我看那块石头，我才发现它没有照片里那么大，坐上去脚还能放在地上。
lines.py: dì èr gè zhōu mò , wǒ men dài shuǐ hé yī diǎn chī de qù hé biān . tā zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn nà kuài shí tou , wǒ cái fā xiàn tā méi yǒu zhào piān lǐ nà me dà , zuò shàng qù jiǎo hái néng fàng zài dì shang .
lines.en: The following weekend we took water and snacks to the river. She showed me the rock. It was smaller than it looked in the photo; I could sit with my feet on the ground.

lines.zh: 我想拍一张和她上次一样的照片，她站到旁边指了指方向。我把桥也放进画面里，拍完看看，桥又显得很近了。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng pāi yī zhāng hé tā shàng cì yī yàng de zhào piān , tā zhàn dào páng biān zhǐ le zhǐ fāng xiàng . wǒ bǎ qiáo yě fàng jìn huà miàn lǐ , pāi wán kàn kàn , qiáo yòu xiǎn de hěn jìn le .
lines.en: I wanted a photo like hers. She stood beside me and pointed out the angle. I included the bridge and checked the result; once again it looked close.

lines.zh: 这次我们慢慢走到桥边，没有遇到雨。桥上风很大，我拿出一根香蕉，朋友说别站着吃，我们下去找地方坐。
lines.py: zhè cì wǒ men màn màn zǒu dào qiáo biān , méi yǒu yù dào yǔ . qiáo shàng fēng hěn dà , wǒ ná chū yī gēn xiāng jiāo , péng you shuō bié zhàn zhe chī , wǒ men xià qù zhǎo dì fāng zuò .
lines.en: This time we walked slowly to the bridge and had no rain. It was windy up there. When I took out a banana, my friend suggested finding a place to sit below.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我把照片发给陈宇。他问从石头走到桥要多久，我说二十分钟，别只看照片就以为下车已经到了。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi chén yǔ . tā wèn cóng shí tou zǒu dào qiáo yào duō jiǔ , wǒ shuō èr shí fēn zhōng , bié zhǐ kàn zhào piān jiù yǐ wéi xià chē yǐ jīng dào le .
lines.en: Back home I sent the photo to Chen Yu. He asked about the walk from the rock to the bridge. Twenty minutes, I said; the photo did not mean he would arrive as soon as he stepped off the bus.

questions.q: What does the second visit reveal?
choices: The rock is smaller and the bridge farther than they look
questions.answer: The rock is smaller and the bridge farther than they look

questions.q: Does it rain during their second visit?

choices: The photo makes the distance look short

lines.zh: 这张照片里，你看起来比我高。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān lǐ , nǐ kàn qǐ lái bǐ wǒ gāo .
lines.en: You look taller than me in this photo.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我站在石头上，你站在沙子里。
lines.py: wǒ zhàn zài shí tou shàng , nǐ zhàn zài shā zi lǐ .
lines.en: I'm standing on the rock; you're in the sand.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怪不得。我还以为自己变矮了。
lines.py: guài bu de . wǒ hái yǐ wéi zì jǐ biàn ǎi le .
lines.en: No wonder. I thought I'd got shorter.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 要不要换个位置再拍？
lines.py: yào bù yào huàn gè wèi zhì zài pāi ?
lines.en: Shall we swap places for another photo?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要。这次让我站石头上。
lines.py: yào . zhè cì ràng wǒ zhàn shí tou shàng .
lines.en: Yes. Let me stand on the rock this time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，但石头就这么高，别期待变成大树。
lines.py: hǎo , dàn shí tou jiù zhè me gāo , bié qī dài biàn chéng dà shù .
lines.en: Sure, but the rock is only so tall. Don't expect to turn into a tree.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: zhè dào cài kàn shàng qù hěn hǎo chī .
lines.en: This dish looks delicious.

lines.zh: 那座桥看上去很近。
lines.py: nà zuò qiáo kàn shàng qù hěn jìn .
lines.en: That bridge looks close.

lines.zh: 我坐在窗边观察街上的人。
lines.py: wǒ zuò zài chuāng biān guān chá jiē shàng de rén .
lines.en: I sat by the window watching people in the street.

lines.zh: 老师让我们观察叶子的变化。
lines.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men guān chá yè zi de biàn huà .
lines.en: The teacher asked us to observe changes in the leaves.

lines.zh: 山上的景色很美。
lines.py: shān shàng de jǐng sè hěn měi .
lines.en: The scenery on the mountain is beautiful.

lines.zh: 她拍下了窗外的景色。
lines.py: tā pāi xià le chuāng wài de jǐng sè .
lines.en: She photographed the scenery outside the window.

lines.zh: 这朵花真美。
lines.py: zhè duǒ huā zhēn měi .
lines.en: This flower is beautiful.

lines.zh: 我喜欢这里安静的美。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān zhè lǐ ān jìng de měi .
lines.en: I like this place's quiet beauty.

lines.zh: 我们一起度过了一段美好的时光。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ dù guò le yī duàn měi hǎo de shí guāng .
lines.en: We spent a wonderful time together.

lines.zh: 她对未来有很多美好的想法。
lines.py: tā duì wèi lái yǒu hěn duō měi hǎo de xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: She has many lovely ideas about the future.

lines.zh: 这是一个美丽的小城。
lines.py: zhè shì yī gè měi lì de xiǎo chéng .
lines.en: This is a beautiful little town.

lines.zh: 她给我看了一张美丽的照片。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ kàn le yī zhāng měi lì de zhào piān .
lines.en: She showed me a beautiful photo.

lines.zh: 今天的天空很蓝。
lines.py: jīn tiān de tiān kōng hěn lán .
lines.en: The sky is very blue today.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天空。
lines.py: wǒ tái tóu kàn le kàn tiān kōng .
lines.en: I looked up at the sky.

lines.zh: 阳光照在桌子上。
lines.py: yáng guāng zhào zài zhuō zi shàng .
lines.en: Sunlight falls on the table.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的阳光很好。
lines.py: zhè jiān wū zi de yáng guāng hěn hǎo .
lines.en: This room gets good sunlight.

lines.zh: 照片里的猫很胖。
lines.py: zhào piān lǐ de māo hěn pàng .
lines.en: The cat in the photo is fat.

lines.zh: 这件衣服让我看起来有点胖。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú ràng wǒ kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn pàng .
lines.en: This outfit makes me look a little heavier.

lines.zh: 帮我拍一张照片吧。
lines.py: bāng wǒ pāi yī zhāng zhào piān ba .
lines.en: Take a photo of me, please.

lines.zh: 他把刚才的表演拍下来了。
lines.py: tā bǎ gāng cái de biǎo yǎn pāi xià lái le .
lines.en: He filmed the performance.

lines.zh: 这张图画了房间的位置。
lines.py: zhè zhāng tú huà le fáng jiān de wèi zhì .
lines.en: This diagram shows the rooms' positions.

lines.zh: 我想把图放大一点。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ tú fàng dà yī diǎn .
lines.en: I'd like to enlarge the picture.

lines.zh: 墙上挂着孩子的图画。
lines.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe hái zi de tú huà .
lines.en: The child's drawing hangs on the wall.

lines.zh: 这本书里的图画很好看。
lines.py: zhè běn shū lǐ de tú huà hěn hǎo kàn .
lines.en: The illustrations in this book are lovely.

lines.zh: 我的鞋里进了沙子。
lines.py: wǒ de xié lǐ jìn le shā zi .
lines.en: Sand got into my shoe.

lines.zh: 孩子们在沙子里挖了一个洞。
lines.py: hái zi men zài shā zi lǐ wā le yī gè dòng .
lines.en: The children dug a hole in the sand.

lines.zh: 他坐在一块大石头上。
lines.py: tā zuò zài yī kuài dà shí tou shàng .
lines.en: He sat on a large rock.

lines.zh: 这块石头摸起来很凉。
lines.py: zhè kuài shí tou mō qǐ lái hěn liáng .
lines.en: This stone feels cool.

lines.zh: 过了桥就是车站。
lines.py: guò le qiáo jiù shì chē zhàn .
lines.en: The station is across the bridge.

lines.zh: 我们在桥边等你。
lines.py: wǒ men zài qiáo biān děng nǐ .
lines.en: We'll wait beside the bridge.

lines.zh: 图画里的龙是蓝色的。
lines.py: tú huà lǐ de lóng shì lán sè de .
lines.en: The dragon in the drawing is blue.

lines.zh: 这件衣服上画着一条龙。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú shàng huà zhe yī tiáo lóng .
lines.en: There is a dragon on this garment.

lines.zh: 草地上有两头牛。
lines.py: cǎo dì shàng yǒu liǎng tóu niú .
lines.en: There are two cows on the grass.

lines.zh: 他小时候在家里帮忙喂牛。
lines.py: tā xiǎo shí hòu zài jiā lǐ bāng máng wèi niú .
lines.en: He helped feed cows at home as a child.

lines.zh: 这只羊一直跟着我。
lines.py: zhè zhǐ yáng yì zhí gēn zhe wǒ .
lines.en: This sheep keeps following me.

lines.zh: 山上有一群羊。
lines.py: shān shàng yǒu yī qún yáng .
lines.en: There is a flock of sheep on the mountain.

lines.zh: 那只小猪睡着了。
lines.py: nà zhǐ xiǎo zhū shuì zháo le .
lines.en: That piglet has fallen asleep.

lines.zh: 弟弟画了一只很胖的猪。
lines.py: dì di huà le yī zhǐ hěn pàng de zhū .
lines.en: My younger brother drew a very fat pig.

lines.zh: 我早上吃了一根香蕉。
lines.py: wǒ zǎo shàng chī le yī gēn xiāng jiāo .
lines.en: I had a banana this morning.

lines.zh: 这些香蕉还没熟。
lines.py: zhè xiē xiāng jiāo hái méi shú .
lines.en: These bananas are not ripe yet.

lines.zh: 她给我一个红苹果。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ yī gè hóng píng guǒ .
lines.en: She gave me a red apple.

lines.zh: 苹果放在桌上的袋子里。
lines.py: píng guǒ fàng zài zhuō shàng de dài zi lǐ .
lines.en: The apples are in the bag on the table.

audio.zh: 走了二十分钟，比照片里远。
audio.py: zǒu le èr shí fēn zhōng , bǐ zhào piān lǐ yuǎn .
audio.en: It took twenty minutes; it's farther than it looks in the photo.

tasks.why: This heard line explicitly supplies the information.

audio.zh: 回家以后，我把照片发给陈宇。他问从石头走到桥要多久，我说二十分钟，别只看照片就以为下车已经到了。
audio.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi chén yǔ . tā wèn cóng shí tou zǒu dào qiáo yào duō jiǔ , wǒ shuō èr shí fēn zhōng , bié zhǐ kàn zhào piān jiù yǐ wéi xià chē yǐ jīng dào le .
audio.en: Back home I sent the photo to Chen Yu. He asked about the walk from the rock to the bridge. Twenty minutes, I said; the photo did not mean he would arrive as soon as he stepped off the bus.

tasks.statement: The narrator tells Chen Yu the bridge is right beside the rock.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly gives a different result.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三35, 三36. Native check: overlapping 看起来/看上去 uses, 羊 as a general sheep/goat label, animal classifiers, nonjudgmental 胖 use for a model, the banana-as-mountain joke, photograph framing and permission scope. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三28 / 三38 / 三32 / 三53: 除了看节目，我还听广播。, 除了周五，其他几天都可以。, 老师张先生也来了。, 她汉语说得很流利。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: a classmate helps with a small article, friends choose a rainy-day film venue, a photo makes a bridge look close, and two adults start swimming lessons. Removed identity/privacy/assessment cautions and report-like conversation. All target words have independently authored contexts instead of being stuffed into speech. Formed six text questions and nine or ten mixed tasks from the actual new facts while keeping all old IDs. Native flags: colloquial teasing about tickets and photos; 大主语/小主语 description; 好是好，就是; time-from 起 and elapsed 了; 精神 jīngshén as spirit versus the earlier energetic jīngshen; 录 as a bound verb in 录入; realistic descriptions of a first swimming class. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
